text: The Fed has removed rate cut expectations and is now considering hikes to ~4.2% by year-end while GDP growth has slowed to 1.5% — this stagflation-lite mix of sticky 3.4% inflation, rising rate risk, and slowing growth is a headwind for speculative and growth holdings in your portfolio.
QBTS is down 41%, losing money with a negative PE, has 22% short interest betting against it, and sits 63% below its high — the thesis is broken and this capital is better deployed elsewhere.
RGTI is your worst performer at -46% with revenue shrinking 34% and massive losses — there is no fundamental support here and you should exit to stop the bleeding.
IONQ is down 24% with negative earnings, bearish technicals across the board, and 10% short interest — another unprofitable quantum computing name that should be sold before further damage.
NCLP.L is down 23% with deeply bearish technicals below its 50-day average and carries a REDUCE signal — cut this position back meaningfully to limit further downside.
MU combines a remarkably cheap PE of 5.9 with 49% revenue growth riding the AI memory boom — this is the strongest risk/reward setup in your portfolio for adding on any pullback.
GOOGL at a PE of 23 with 15% revenue growth, strong free cash flow, and insider buying is a quality large-cap worth adding to as a defensive growth anchor in this uncertain macro environment.
